trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Every trophy is offline single-player, so one playthrough is enough [1][2]. It is the last trophy by definition, so treat it as the finish line of the roadmap, not a task of its own [4].
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.t: Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then strangers and cleanup [1][2].
Keep the single possibly missable trophy safe: do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (see Positive Mental Attitude) [1].
Track the 54 others here; the platinum unlocks automatically when the last one lands [4].
No online play, no DLC and no difficulty setting are involved [1][2].

trophies.track: Track the other 54 here — this one pops last.
trophies.hundo: The platinum itself — it pops when the other 54 are earned, not from the checklist.

Follow the on-screen objectives to the end of the mission; the trophy pops on completion [2].

If you are chasing the missable meditation, do it right after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth (see Positive Mental Attitude) [1].

trophies.guide: Gold for reaching 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which appears under Progress, then Stats, after the story [1][2]. Both PowerPyx and KeenGamer call it the hardest trophy, but the thresholds are lenient — PowerPyx says it is closer to 60% true completion [1]. Only some tasks need everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests [1].
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.t: Finish the story first; the checklist only becomes visible afterwards, but earlier progress already counts [1].
Clear every robbery the checklist asks for: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs and 8 bank vault robberies [2].
Finish the collectible lines: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries and 100 flamingos [2][7].
Win the races, earn all 42 shooting-range gold medals and finish the drone races [2].
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges — you may skip the 10 hardest [1].
Scan 200 of 277 vehicle models and study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars [1].
Check Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after each session and clear the shortest lines first [1][2].

Stop at 250 for this trophy, but keep a note: 100% completion asks for 300 [1].
Log your count here; the tracker widget counts up to 250 [2].

Work through the 42 challenges one range at a time [1].

Use the weapon the challenge hands you; bringing your own loadout does not help [1].
Gold medals also count toward 100% completion, so finish all 42 before moving on [1][2].

disputes.topic: How long is the platinum — 200 or 300 hours?
disputes.a: PowerPyx, KeenGamer, GTA-Base and GAMES.GG all put the platinum at about 200 hours.
disputes.b: Push Square puts the platinum at 300 hours or more.
disputes.verdict: Our call: plan 200 hours and budget 300. Both sides agree A Long Road (100%) is the longest grind either way.

disputes.topic: How long is the story — 60–80 or 50–60 hours?
disputes.a: PowerPyx, KeenGamer and GTAZone count 60–80 hours for the story and optional missions.
disputes.b: Beebom (reported by Gaming Route) puts the main campaign at 50–60 hours, and Insider Gaming (via GameRant) also reports ~50 hours for the main path [24].
disputes.verdict: Our call: 60–80 hours if you do optional missions as they appear; 50–60 is the main path only.

disputes.topic: Cunning Stunts — 250 or 300 stunts?
disputes.a: The trophy needs any 250 stunts; PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in the game.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist asks for 300 stunts, so guides quoting 300 describe 100%, not this trophy.
disputes.verdict: Our call: do 250 for the trophy, 300 for A Long Road.

disputes.topic: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation actually required?
disputes.a: PowerPyx flags the Chapter 1 balcony meditation as the one possibly missable spot.
disputes.b: GAMES.GG says whether it is required remains unconfirmed; GTAZone notes 100% only needs 15 of 18 spots.
disputes.verdict: Our call: do it anyway — it costs minutes and removes the only known risk.

disputes.topic: Do stranger chains have story-progress windows?
disputes.a: PowerPyx and KeenGamer say every stranger chain can be finished after the story.
disputes.b: TechWiser, reported by eGamers, says the stranger chains behind five hidden trophies have windows linked to story progress.
disputes.verdict: Our call: play each chain as it appears — safe on both readings.

disputes.topic: Strangers & Freaks — which strands actually count?
disputes.a: The official description says any 8 mission strands for strangers.
disputes.b: GTAZone says only some count (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy don’t); GAMES.GG agrees Andy, Billy and Tyrone don’t count.
disputes.verdict: Our call: follow the named list — don’t count Andy, Billy or Tyrone toward the 8.

disputes.topic: Grade split — 6 Silver / 46 Bronze or 5 / 47?
disputes.a: PowerPyx, Insider Gaming and GTA-Base give 1P, 2G, 6S, 46B.
disputes.b: Push Square counts 5 Silver and 47 Bronze.
disputes.verdict: Our call: 6 Silver / 46 Bronze — the majority, and it matches the Exophase list.

disputes.topic: Don’t Touch My Deck — 3 or 15 card sets?
disputes.a: The trophy needs 3 complete Collectible Card sets.
disputes.b: Some guides quote 15 sets — that is the 100% number (15 of 18 sets).
disputes.verdict: Our call: 3 sets for the trophy, 15 for A Long Road.

disputes.topic: Whip It Good — discover 100 or scan 200 vehicles?
disputes.a: The trophy wants 100 vehicles discovered.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned.
disputes.verdict: Our call: 100 for the trophy, 200 for A Long Road — scanning counts as discovering.

disputes.topic: One Last Thing — 50 or 70 challenges?
disputes.a: The trophy needs 50 challenges completed.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist wants any 70 of 80 challenges.
disputes.verdict: Our call: 50 for the trophy, 70 for A Long Road — you may skip the hardest 10.

disputes.topic: Maximum Withdrawal — 5 or 8 bank vaults?
disputes.a: The trophy needs any 5 bank vaults robbed, out of 8.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults.
disputes.verdict: Our call: 5 for the trophy, 8 for A Long Road.

disputes.b: The 100% checklist wants all 39 gang operations cleared.
disputes.verdict: Our call: 9 gangs for the trophy, 39 operations for A Long Road.

disputes.topic: Meditation — the trophy wants MORE than 100%?
disputes.a: The trophy wants all 18 meditation spots.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist only wants 15 of 18 spots.
disputes.verdict: Our call: yes — this trophy needs more than 100% does. A missed Chapter 1 spot cannot cost you A Long Road, but it can cost you this trophy.

disputes.topic: Ten Pin — what is the melee drive-by method?
disputes.a: PowerPyx reads it as knocking 10 pedestrians off a bike within 60 seconds.
disputes.b: KeenGamer says the precise method is still being confirmed.
disputes.verdict: Our call: unconfirmed. The PowerPyx reading is the best lead, not a confirmed method.

disputes.topic: Let’s Go Bowling — do you actually bowl?
disputes.a: PowerPyx and GAMES.GG say it is stealing 3 valuables at Kingpin Bowling (watch, shotgun, safe contents).
disputes.b: The official hint (“Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley”) reads like bowling a game.
disputes.verdict: Our call: steal the 3 valuables — no guide says you bowl a game.

disputes.topic: Fair Game — which unique animal?
disputes.a: The trophy says: hunt a unique animal for Bret.
disputes.b: GTAZone says the exact animal isn’t confirmed; PowerPyx says Bret’s questline is Jason-only after Chapter 2.
disputes.verdict: Our call: follow Bret’s quest markers and hunt what he asks for — don’t guess the animal in advance.

disputes.topic: Bad Luck, I Guess — is the Prologue-store method real?
disputes.a: PowerPyx gives the full method: Lucia robs a Payday Loans store in the Prologue; return alone as Lucia after Chapter 3 (Credit Check) and rob the same store again.
disputes.b: Other guides still list this trophy as unconfirmed.
disputes.verdict: Our call: the PowerPyx method is the only detailed report — best lead, single source.

disputes.topic: Personal Best — max Strength with both characters?
disputes.a: GAMES.GG says: reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia (train together at fitness clubs).
disputes.b: Other guides still list this trophy as unconfirmed.
disputes.verdict: Our call: single-source lead — plausible, not confirmed by a second source.

disputes.topic: Actions Speak Louder — 500 Criminal Profile actions?
disputes.a: GAMES.GG says it needs 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.
disputes.b: Other guides still list this trophy as unconfirmed.
disputes.verdict: Our call: single-source lead — robberies and enemy encounters contribute naturally, so don’t grind it separately.

disputes.topic: The Truth Is Out There — what triggers it?
disputes.a: PowerPyx lists this trophy’s condition as unknown.
disputes.b: GameRant gives a full method: a UFO abduction at Port Gellhorn, Kelly County, around 2 AM — find the abandoned car, follow it to a floating woman, speak with her, fetch her car, and you wake three in-game days later with the trophy [23].
disputes.verdict: Our call: follow GameRant's lead — it is the only detailed method published — but treat it as uncorroborated until a second guide confirms it.

disputes.topic: Little Boxes — all garages, or only the 8 buyable ones?
disputes.a: The official description says “purchase all garage properties”.
disputes.b: GAMES.GG and KeenGamer say only the 8 purchasable garages count; the 4 story garages don’t. Total $160,000.
disputes.verdict: Our call: buy the 8 — the story garages are excluded.

disputes.topic: Is 100% completion the same as doing everything?
disputes.a: PowerPyx says the checklist is “closer to 60% true completion” — most side quests aren’t needed.
disputes.b: “Attain 100% Completion” sounds like doing everything in the game.
disputes.verdict: Our call: the checklist is a subset. Strangers & Freaks, most side quests and many collectibles are NOT on it.

disputes.topic: Catch Me If You Can — which plane, and how far?
disputes.a: GAMES.GG gives the full method: a large passenger plane at a boarding bridge (terminals E3/E4), cockpit, reverse to the runway, fly about 1 km away.
disputes.b: Other guides give only the description: “Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.”
disputes.verdict: Our call: use the detailed method — single-source lead, but the only actionable one.

disputes.topic: Retail Therapy — does the wanted level have to stay up between shops?
disputes.a: GAMES.GG says yes: keep the red-and-blue flashing pursuit active between shops; the trophy can pop ~30 seconds after leaving the final shop.
disputes.b: The bare description says only “rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level”.
disputes.verdict: Our call: follow GAMES.GG — staying in the red heat zone without an active wanted level does NOT count.

disputes.topic: Meditation spots — 18 spots, or 36 meditations?
disputes.a: KeenGamer lists 18 required meditation spots across Leonida [2].
disputes.b: PowerPyx's 100% checklist counts a spot twice when both characters meditate there [20].
disputes.verdict: Our call: 18 spots; meditate with both characters at each spot and the checklist advances twice — do both where you can.

disputes.topic: Optional story tasks — missable, or irrelevant?
disputes.a: PowerPyx warns a few optional tasks during the story are missable [1].
disputes.b: The same guide says they don't matter, since 200–300 optional tasks exist and only 200 count toward 100% [20].
disputes.verdict: Our call: some are one-chance, but 100% has slack — don't restart for one missed task.

disputes.topic: WAiNK scans — one objective or two?
disputes.a: GAMES.GG says vehicle scanning is separate from environmental scans [12].
disputes.b: Exophase lists 'WAiNK It at 100 locations' as a single requirement [4].
disputes.verdict: Our call: separate counters — vehicles and locations are tracked separately; both feed the 100% checklist.

disputes.topic: Shooting range — 42 challenges or 12 ranges?
disputes.a: KeenGamer counts 42 Shooting Range Gold Medals [2].
disputes.b: GTAZone frames the same requirement as 12 shooting ranges [6].
disputes.verdict: Our call: 42 golds spread across 12 ranges — the same requirement counted two ways.

disputes.topic: Top Fun — 14 locations or 42 time trials?
disputes.a: KeenGamer: win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations [2].
disputes.b: PowerPyx's checklist counts 42/42 Top Fun Drone Time Trials [20].
disputes.verdict: Our call: different activities — races for the trophy, time trials for 100%; do both. PowerPyx adds a third number: beat the par time on 28 of the 42 races (the first 2 at each of the 14 locations).

disputes.topic: Wildlife — 170 species or 255 animals?
disputes.a: Rockstar announced 170 wildlife species (reported by GameRant) [24].
disputes.b: PowerPyx's checklist wants 100 of 255 animals studied [20].
disputes.verdict: Our call: 255 counts individual animals and variants, not species — study any 100 of them.

disputes.topic: Cheats — locked until after the story, or just dangerous?
disputes.a: PowerPyx: using a cheat disables trophies and saving [1].
disputes.b: Dexerto: cheats can only be used once you've beaten the main story [25].
disputes.verdict: Our call: both true — cheats are locked until after the final mission, and even then they disable trophies. Keep them off the trophy run entirely.

disputes.topic: Hidden trophies — 28 or 27?
disputes.a: Exophase, TrueAchievements, TrueTrophies (via Vi.ki) and most lists count 28 hidden trophies.
disputes.b: Push Square marks 27 hidden — SixShore notes the split explicitly: “Hidden 28 (Push Square marks 27)”.
disputes.verdict: Our call: 28. The tracker lists agree with each other and with the 27-visible / 28-hidden split every other list prints; Push Square is the outlier.

disputes.topic: Is the platinum worth Gamerscore — 0 or 1,000?
disputes.a: TrueAchievements and GameMapa: Vice Got a Price! is worth 0 Gamerscore on Xbox; the 1,000G total comes from the other 54 trophies.
disputes.b: Leonida Hub and eGamers describe the whole list as “worth 1,000G” without splitting the platinum out.
disputes.verdict: Our call: the platinum itself is 0G; 1,000G is the sum of the other 54. On PS5 it is 300 PSN points, like any platinum.

disputes.topic: How many story missions — about 100, or unconfirmed?
disputes.a: Insider Gaming’s leak, reported by GameRant, puts the story at about 100 missions across 5 chapters.
disputes.b: PowerPyx and KeenGamer publish no mission count at all — their roadmaps are organised by chapter, not by mission.
disputes.verdict: Our call: treat ~100 as a leak, not a fact. Plan around chapters, not a mission count, until a guide counts them.

disputes.topic: Master of None — which nine activities count?
disputes.a: PowerPyx and GameMapa name the nine: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, a stunt.
disputes.b: KeenGamer and several lists say only “nine activity types” without naming them.
disputes.verdict: Our call: follow the nine named by PowerPyx and GameMapa — a race and a stunt both count as activities, so two of the nine come free from other trophies.

disputes.topic: Dime on the Dollar — fence via Yasmani, or any contact?
disputes.a: PowerPyx: fence marked bills via Yasmani, the fence unlocked in Chapter 3 — Credit Check unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, and Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 after his earlier quests.
disputes.b: Most lists say only “through your contacts”, with no name attached.
disputes.verdict: Our call: Yasmani is the contact that matters — unlock him in Chapter 3 and the $250,000 follows from bank jobs.

disputes.topic: Cheats — how many are there: 61, or uncounted?
disputes.a: Dexerto lists 61 cheat codes for GTA 6.
disputes.b: No other source counts the cheats; PowerPyx and KeenGamer only warn that using one disables trophies and saving.
disputes.verdict: Our call: 61 per Dexerto’s list. The count does not matter for the platinum — keep cheats off this save either way.

disputes.topic: How many vehicles are there — 277 base models or 557?
disputes.a: PowerPyx’s checklist row: scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles.
disputes.b: PowerPyx’s own intro says “scan any 200 of 557 vehicles”.
disputes.verdict: Our call: 277 base models count for the checklist; 557 is every vehicle including boats, aircraft and variants. Scan base models.

disputes.topic: Is the Headliners trophy DWNFALL or DWNFLL?
disputes.a: KeenGamer and Of Zen and Computing spell it DWNFALL.
disputes.b: all.gg, quoting the PSN list directly, spells it DWNFLL — no A.
disputes.verdict: Our call: follow the PSN spelling DWNFLL until the game itself shows otherwise; the trophy is the same one either way — complete Headliners.

disputes.topic: Top Fun or Top Run drone races?
disputes.a: KeenGamer, GamesFuze, GAMES.GG and Of Zen and Computing all call the drone races Top Fun.
disputes.b: all.gg, quoting the PSN list, writes “Win a Top Run Drone Race at every location”.
disputes.verdict: Our call: the activity is the same — win one drone race at every venue. Top Fun is the name the guides use; Top Run looks like the PSN wording for the same races.

disputes.topic: How much Gamerscore is a Silver worth — 40G or 50G?
disputes.a: GamesFuze puts every Silver at 40G.
disputes.b: Of Zen and Computing puts every Silver at 50G, and GameMapa's full list agrees on the 1,000G total.
disputes.verdict: Our call: 50G per Silver. Six Silvers at 50G plus two Golds at 100G plus 46 Bronzes at 10G is exactly 1,000G; at 40G the Silvers would leave the total 60G short.

disputes.topic: How much Gamerscore is the final-story Gold worth — 50G or 100G?
disputes.a: GamesFuze gives the final-story Gold 50G and the 100% Gold 100G.
disputes.b: Of Zen and Computing gives both Golds 100G each.
disputes.verdict: Our call: 100G each. Two Golds at 100G is the only split that reaches 1,000G with Silvers at 50G and Bronzes at 10G; a 50G Gold would break the total.

disputes.topic: Are all Bronzes worth 10G, or do some pay 5G and 15G?
disputes.a: Of Zen and Computing gives every Bronze a flat 10G.
disputes.b: GamesFuze and GameMapa give mixed values — 5G for the opening mission, 15G and 20G for others.
disputes.verdict: Our call: the flat 10G table is the cleaner read (46 × 10G = 460G, which the 1,000G total needs), but treat per-trophy Gamerscore as unsettled — the PSN trophy grades, not the Xbox points, are what this guide tracks.

disputes.topic: Do cheats disable trophies in GTA 6?
disputes.a: Mobalytics warns plainly: using cheats will disable trophies, so keep them off.
disputes.b: Of Zen and Computing says only that cheats have historically locked achievements in Rockstar games and GTA 6 is expected to follow the same pattern — expected, not confirmed in-game.
disputes.verdict: Our call: keep cheats off your platinum save entirely. The downside of being wrong is a ruined run; the upside of testing it is nothing.

disputes.topic: How long is the story alone — 50 hours or 60–80?
disputes.a: Of Zen and Computing puts the main story at 50–60 hours.
disputes.b: KeenGamer budgets 60–80 hours for the story block, and the Insider Gaming leak reported ~50 hours for the main path.
disputes.verdict: Our call: plan 60 hours for the story and 200 for the platinum. The 50-hour figure is the leak's main-path number; side missions and optional content push real playtime up.

disputes.topic: Can you miss any trophy at all?
disputes.a: PowerPyx, KeenGamer, GTA-Base and eGamers all flag Positive Mental Attitude as the one possibly missable trophy.
disputes.b: Of Zen and Computing reports community discussion suggesting you may not be able to miss any trophy, and calls that unconfirmed.
disputes.verdict: Our call: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation anyway. It costs one morning in-game; skipping it on an unconfirmed rumour risks the whole run.

disputes.topic: How many meditation spots — 18, or just “every spot”?
disputes.a: KeenGamer counts 18 required meditation spots across Leonida.
disputes.b: PowerPyx, all.gg and Of Zen and Computing say only “every spot” / “every meditation spot”, with no number.
disputes.verdict: Our call: use 18 as the working count and the in-game checklist as the truth. If the checklist shows spots left after 18, keep going — the count is a guide, the checklist is the game.

disputes.topic: How many Top Fun drone-race locations — 14, or “every location”?
disputes.a: KeenGamer counts 14 Top Fun drone-race locations.
disputes.b: PowerPyx, all.gg and Of Zen and Computing say only “every location” / “every venue”, with no number.
disputes.verdict: Our call: use 14 as the working count and win one race at each venue you find. The trophy pops on the last venue, so the count only matters for planning.

disputes.topic: How many card sets count toward 100% — 3, or 15 of 18?
disputes.a: The trophy needs 3 complete Collectible Card sets.
disputes.b: Push Square's 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 card sets for full completion.
disputes.verdict: Our call: both are right — 3 sets pop the trophy, 15 of 18 feed the 100% checklist. Do not stop at 3 if you are chasing A Long Road.

disputes.topic: Earn Cash, Not Kudos — any 20 races, or 20 different ones?
disputes.a: all.gg and Of Zen and Computing both say “Win 20 different races” — distinct events, not repeats.
disputes.b: Shorter lists write only “Win 20 races”, which reads as if repeating one race 20 times would count.
disputes.verdict: Our call: win 20 different races. “Different” is in the trophy's own wording as reported by two full lists; do not grind one race.

disputes.topic: Is the animal study 170 species?
disputes.a: Of Zen and Computing reports the animal study grind covers 170 species, echoing Red Dead Redemption 2.
disputes.b: PowerPyx's 100% checklist counts 100 of 255 animals for the checklist, a different number for a different task.
disputes.verdict: Our call: do not confuse the two numbers. 170 species is the reported study total; 100 of 255 animals is the checklist row. Follow the checklist row for A Long Road.

disputes.topic: Does the final story trophy pop for Chapter 5 or for the final mission?
disputes.a: Of Zen and Computing lists it as “Complete Chapter 5”.
disputes.b: KeenGamer, Push Square and all.gg list it as “Complete the final mission” / “Finish the final story mission”.
disputes.verdict: Our call: same moment either way — finishing the final mission ends Chapter 5. Play to the credits and it pops.

disputes.topic: How many Shooting Range challenges are there — 42, or just “all of them”?
disputes.a: KeenGamer and GamesFuze both count 42 Shooting Range Gold Medals.
disputes.b: PowerPyx and all.gg say only “all Shooting Range challenges” / “a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges”, with no number.
disputes.verdict: Our call: use 42 as the working count. Two full lists agree on it, and the trophy pops on the last gold either way.

disputes.topic: How many activity types does Master of None need — nine, or just “each type”?
disputes.a: KeenGamer counts nine activity types, and GameMapa also lists 9 activity types.
disputes.b: PowerPyx, all.gg and Of Zen and Computing say only “each type of activity” / “every type of activity”, with no number.
disputes.verdict: Our call: nine. Two lists agree on the number; try one of each activity type the map offers and the trophy pops on the ninth.

disputes.topic: How many garage properties are there — eight, or just “all of them”?
disputes.a: KeenGamer counts eight purchasable garage properties for Little Boxes.
disputes.b: all.gg and Of Zen and Computing say only “all garage properties” / “every garage property on the map”, with no number.
disputes.verdict: Our call: use eight as the working count and buy every garage the map offers. The trophy pops on the last purchase either way.

disputes.topic: One Last Thing: 50 challenges — or 70 of 80?
disputes.a: The trophy needs 50 completed challenges.
disputes.b: PowerPyx's 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80 challenges.
disputes.verdict: Our call: both are right — 50 pops the trophy, 70 of 80 feeds the checklist. Do not stop at 50 if you are chasing A Long Road.

disputes.topic: Whip It Good: 100 vehicles — or 200 scanned?
disputes.a: The trophy needs 100 vehicles discovered.
disputes.b: PowerPyx's 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned.
disputes.verdict: Our call: both are right — 100 discovered pops the trophy, 200 of 277 scanned feeds the checklist. WAiNK scanning counts toward both.

disputes.topic: You WAiNKer!: 100 locations — or 200 vehicles?
disputes.a: The trophy needs WAiNK It at 100 locations.
disputes.b: The checklist's vehicle row needs 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, which also uses WAiNK.
disputes.verdict: Our call: different counters that share one tool. 100 WAiNK locations pops the trophy; keep scanning past it and the 200-vehicle checklist row fills too.

steps.t: Play Chapters 1–2 in order; pick up optional missions as they appear (purple icons, black icons with pink letters).
After the mission Down to Earth, do Lucia’s balcony meditation at Jason’s house in the morning — the one possibly missable trophy.
Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals through binoculars as you travel — both count toward 100% later.
Do the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling (Let’s Go Bowling) and start Bret’s chain when his text arrives after Coffee Break.
Cross-check every story trophy name against the PSN list as reported by all.gg — it spells the Headliners trophy DWNFLL, not DWNFALL (see dispute D39).
Budget the story at 50–60 hours and the platinum at about 200 hours; the gap is the side content, not the story.

roadmap.hours: Rest of the 60–80 hour story block
roadmap.save: Save at the start and end of Chapters 3, 4 and 5 — missions cannot be replayed.

steps.t: Play Chapters 3–5 in order to the final mission.
In Chapter 3, do Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun (Sneakthief) and finish Credit Check to unlock Payday Loans and the Dye Pack Jammer.
In Chapter 4, take the optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…” to open bank vaults (Maximum Withdrawal).
Keep cheats off this save — they disable trophies and saving.
Finish Chapter 5 by completing the final mission — the Gold pops at the credits either way (see dispute D52).
Save before the final mission — there is no mission replay, so the ending cannot be redone on this save.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Free-roam: the 100% checklist
roadmap.save: Save before big spends — the 8 purchasable garages cost $160,000 in total.

Robberies first: all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs and 8 vaults.
Collectibles: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 cocaine flamingos.
Grind rows: 300 of 397 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied.
Win 20 different races for Earn Cash, Not Kudos — repeats of one race do not count (see dispute D50).
Use the WAiNK app while exploring: scanning feeds both the 100-location WAiNK count and the 200-vehicle discovery count.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 — Strangers & misc cleanup
roadmap.save: Save before each stranger final mission — the chains are the only at-risk set.

steps.t: Finish the stranger strands as they appear — only some count toward Strangers & Freaks (Andy, Billy and Tyrone don’t).
Finish Bret’s hunting quests (Jason-only, 15 Target Decks) and the partner trophies with your partner.
Clean up the hidden one-offs: VCIA departure, the Rhino, the bowling valuables, the Ocean Beach cocktail.
Leave the 5 unconfirmed trophies for last — check the guide for the best single-source lead on each.
Finish eight stranger strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each end with a final mission, plus Bret's hunt.
Check the FAQ tab before hunting the 5 unconfirmed trophies — each has its best lead and its warning there.

roadmap.save: Keep cheats off until the platinum pops — one cheat disables trophies and saving on this save.

steps.t: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through contacts (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most).
Spend $100,000 across all shops, buy the 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total) and register 10 vehicles via the Scooter Bros app.
Check the tracker: the platinum pops the moment the 54th other trophy lands.
Do not touch cheats: they unlock only after the story, and any active cheat disables trophies and blocks saving [25][1].
Launder Marked Bills through contacts until $250,000 is done, then spend $100,000 across shops — the two money trophies are separate grinds.

faq.q: How many trophies does GTA 6 have?
faq.a: 55 on PlayStation 5: 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver and 46 Bronze. 28 of them are hidden until you unlock them, and the same 55 appear as Xbox achievements worth 1,000 Gamerscore.

faq.q: How long does the platinum take?
faq.a: About 200 hours is the consensus — PowerPyx, KeenGamer and Of Zen and Computing all land there. Push Square says 300 hours or more. Plan 200, budget 300; A Long Road (100%) is the longest grind either way.

faq.q: Can I miss any trophy?
faq.a: Only one is flagged possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude, the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia after Down to Earth. Do it before leaving Chapter 1. Community discussion reported by Of Zen and Computing suggests you may not be able to miss any trophy at all, but that is unconfirmed — do the meditation anyway.

faq.q: Do I need to play online?
faq.a: No. All 55 trophies are offline single-player, and one playthrough is enough. There are no online trophies and no difficulty setting involved.

faq.q: Do cheat codes disable trophies?
faq.a: Treat it as yes. Mobalytics warns plainly that using cheats will disable trophies, and Of Zen and Computing notes cheats have historically locked achievements in Rockstar games. Keep cheats off your platinum save.

faq.q: How many story chapters are there?
faq.a: Five chapters. Chapter trophies run from Paradise Lost (Chapter 1) to You Gotta Know When to Get Off (Chapter 5 / the final mission), and the 100% checklist unlocks once the story is finished.

faq.q: What is the difference between A Long Road and the platinum?
faq.a: A Long Road is the Gold trophy for reaching 100% completion on the in-game checklist. The platinum, Vice Got a Price!, pops only when all other 54 trophies are earned — so A Long Road is usually the last Gold before the platinum, not the platinum itself.

faq.q: How much Gamerscore is the list worth on Xbox?
faq.a: 1,000 Gamerscore in total: two Golds at 100G, six Silvers at 50G and 46 Bronzes at 10G. The Platinum is replaced by a Mythic Achievement worth 0G. Some lists give different per-trophy values — see disputes D41, D42 and D43.

faq.q: Which trophy is the hardest?
faq.a: A Long Road (100% completion). PowerPyx, KeenGamer and eGamers all rank it the hardest, ahead of The Shootist (42 Shooting Range gold medals) and the 250-stunt Cunning Stunts grind.

faq.q: How many meditation spots are there?
faq.a: KeenGamer counts 18 required meditation spots across Leonida, starting with the Chapter 1 balcony meditation. Other lists say only “every spot” with no number — use 18 as the working count and the in-game checklist as the truth.

faq.q: How many Top Fun drone-race locations are there?
faq.a: KeenGamer counts 14 locations. Win one drone race at every venue for the Top Fun trophy. Other lists say only “every location” — the trophy pops on the last venue either way.

faq.q: What is the UFO trophy, The Truth Is Out There?
faq.a: A hidden Bronze whose unlock method is still unconfirmed. GameRant reports a UFO location tied to it, and the guide's UFO method is the best current lead — but it is labelled unconfirmed here, not presented as certain.

faq.q: What are Marked Bills, and what is Dime on the Dollar?
faq.a: Marked Bills are cash you launder through your contacts. Dime on the Dollar pops once you have laundered a cumulative $250,000 of them. It is separate from Treat Yo Self, which is $100,000 spent across shops.

faq.q: How should I save during the run?
faq.a: Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter: 15 manual slots and 1 autosave, and there is no mission replay. If a chapter-gated optional mission looks like a one-off, save before it.

faq.q: When does the 100% checklist unlock?
faq.a: When you finish the story. Push Square and PowerPyx both say the checklist appears after the final mission (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion). Everything on it can be done in free-roam afterwards — except the Chapter 1 meditation.

faq.q: How many Shooting Range challenges are there?
faq.a: 42, according to KeenGamer and GamesFuze — earn a gold medal in all of them for The Shootist. Other lists say only “all challenges” with no number; see dispute D53.

faq.q: How many activity types does Master of None need?
faq.a: Nine. KeenGamer and GameMapa both count nine activity types; try one of each type the map offers. See dispute D54.

faq.q: How many garage properties are there?
faq.a: Eight purchasable garages, according to KeenGamer — buy all of them for Little Boxes. Other lists say only “all garage properties”; see dispute D55.

faq.q: What is the difference between 250 stunts and 300 of 397 stunts?
faq.a: 250 stunts pops Cunning Stunts; the 100% checklist needs 300 of the 397 stunts in the game (130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps). Same activity, two different finish lines.

faq.q: Do I need to finish the stranger strands before the story ends?
faq.a: No. Stranger strands open during the story and their final missions can be finished in free-roam afterwards — Push Square notes you can keep exploring Leonida freely once the final mission is done, and the roadmap puts strangers in Stage 4, after the story.
